name: Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Limited
about: Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Limited manufactures and processes textile and allied products/services in India. The company operates through two segments, Process Division and Fabric Division. It is involved in the power generation business with installed wind turbine of 1.25 MW in Dhule, Maharashtra, as well as fabric works and yarn stitching. Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Limited was founded in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.
